summary: XML format: XmlSpec with an optional XPath and encoding. Non-tabular: the parser returns an element, or a list of elements when an XPath is given. Uses lxml when it is installed and falls back to the stdlib ElementTree.
lifecycle_notes: TABULAR=False, so the output seam passes the parsed object through unchanged.
documentation_hooks: Non-tabular formats and the output seam
risks: The XPath result type differs by engine: lxml elements or stdlib ElementTree elements.
When lxml is installed but data is a stdlib element, xml_serialise falls through to ElementTree.
